This use case is included to perform recovery by firing a watchdog reaction upon failure of Execution Management or State Management .
Execution Management shall use this interface to enable supervision of its process(es) by Platform Health Management .
This use case describes the recovery from a critical supervision failure, i.e., Execution Management or State Management processes failed.
